This page is a draft for review. It is not listed or published.
:::

The viewer below plays a **synthetic** stick-figure golf swing. The motion is
hand-shaped from a few keyframed angles. It is not licensed motion capture and
not a traced UpstreamDrift render. Drag the view slider to walk around the
figure; press Play to watch the swing at slow speed. Read the caveats with the figure.

```{=html}
<figure class="swing-viewer motion-viewer" id="motion-viewer" aria-describedby="motion-viewer-caption">
<div class="sv-stage"></div>
<div class="sv-controls">
<button type="button" class="sv-play" aria-pressed="false">Play</button>
<label class="sv-slider-label">Frame <input type="range" class="sv-slider" min="0" max="0" step="1" value="0"></label>
</div>
<label class="av-yaw-label">View angle <input type="range" class="mv-yaw" min="-180" max="180" step="5" value="30"></label>
<p class="sv-readout" aria-live="polite"></p>
<ul class="av-caveats mv-caveats" aria-label="Caveats of the synthetic clip"></ul>
<figcaption id="motion-viewer-caption">A Synthetic Stick-Figure Golf Swing in 3D, drawn as SVG with a perspective projection. Hand-shaped motion, not measured; not licensed motion capture and not a traced UpstreamDrift render. It plays at slow speed only when you press Play.</figcaption>
<noscript><p>The viewer needs JavaScript. The clip is a synthetic, hand-shaped stick-figure swing, not measured motion.</p></noscript>
</figure>
<script src="../js/motion-clip-data.js"></script>
<script src="../js/motion-clip-viewer.js"></script>
```
